stages.title: Market data
stages.purpose: Pulls closed candles, the Pyth mark and the wallet balance, and checks the data is fresh.

modules.name: marketData
modules.role: Fetches closed BTC/ETH/SOL candles from Kraken (Bitfinex as fallback) for every timeframe and hands them to the indicator step.

modules.name: pythMark
modules.role: Reads the live Pyth price the perps venue fills and liquidates on, so you can see how far it sits from the candle close.

modules.name: walletTracker
modules.role: Reads your trading wallet's stablecoin margin and holdings (read-only, no keys) so sizing and P&L use your real capital.

modules.name: freshness
modules.role: Decides whether the newest candle is recent enough to trade on; stale data can never produce a ready plan.

stages.title: Indicators & geometry
stages.purpose: Turns candles into EMAs, Stoch RSI, ATR, swings, zones, diagonals and channels.

modules.name: indicators
modules.role: Computes EMA21/EMA200, Stoch RSI and trend per timeframe and hands them to every later step.

modules.name: candleFeatures
modules.role: Describes each candle (body, wicks, direction) for the indicator step.

modules.name: structure
modules.role: Finds swing highs and lows and session levels, the plain structure you would mark by hand.

modules.name: advancedIndicators
modules.role: Supplies the shared ATR (and VWAP/Bollinger helpers) that stops and geometry are measured in.

modules.name: geometry
modules.role: Draws the chart for the engine: pivots, horizontal zones, diagonals, channels and room to the next level, the same way for longs and shorts.

stages.title: Pattern detection
stages.purpose: Finds momentum flags and coils, tracks their lifecycle and labels each one.

modules.name: patternDetector
modules.role: Spots continuation flags (impulse, tight pullback, EMA21 hold, break) on 1m/3m/5m and says what state each one is in.

modules.name: patternLifecycle
modules.role: Snaps each flag's breakout and kill levels to real zones, merges bull/bear pairs into coils, and says when to look at a chart first.

modules.name: candidateQualifier
modules.role: Labels each flag watch / wait / don't / actionable from room, conflict, exhaustion and the 4h lean, without changing the flag.

stages.title: Bias & top-down
stages.purpose: Says which way each higher timeframe leans and whether a setup trades with or against it.

modules.name: biasMatrix
modules.role: Scores each timeframe's lean and marks every flag and strategy as with or against the higher timeframes, plus its room to the next zone.

modules.name: topDown
modules.role: Rolls the weekly, daily, 4h and 1h leans into one sentiment with a conviction score, higher timeframes weighted most.

stages.title: Trade plan
stages.purpose: Turns one confirmed flag into exact entry, stop, targets and R:R, or a reason not to trade.

modules.name: flagTradePlan
modules.role: Builds the one trade you can act on: entry, stop, TP1/TP2, gross and net R:R after fees, and ready / conditional / rejected with a reason; also runs the V-B shadow variant.

modules.name: riskEngine
modules.role: Works out dollar loss at the stop, position size and the highest safe leverage for each setup against your margin.

modules.name: strategy
modules.role: The older strategy engine (4h trend, 1h scalp, swing, micro-scalp): its own entries and stops, scalp stops capped at 3%.

modules.name: breakoutEntry
modules.role: A shadow breakout-close entry for runner flags; currently unwired from the payload and never a trade input.

modules.name: engine.json
modules.role: The rulebook: every threshold (3R gross, 2.0 net, 3% scalp stop, fees, timeframes) in one file with a configVersion.

modules.name: engine.js
modules.role: Loads the rulebook once and hands the same frozen settings to every module, plus the config snapshot in the payload.

stages.title: Recommendation
stages.purpose: Grades the plan GOOD / WATCH / BAD with reasons and a measured-history outlook.

modules.name: flagRecommendation
modules.role: Gives the call its class (GOOD, WATCH, BAD or DATA_UNAVAILABLE) with what supports it, what argues against it and what would change it.

modules.name: modelEvidence
modules.role: Collects the 21/200 evidence (EMA map, channels, divergence) the recommendation reads; shown in full with include=model.

modules.name: pathOutlook
modules.role: Says what usually happens next for the live flag (retest, runner, false break...) from measured history with a sample size; info only.

stages.title: Delivery
stages.purpose: Packs everything into one payload and serves it over REST and MCP; records served calls and your journal.

modules.name: scalpContext
modules.role: Runs every step above for BTC/ETH/SOL and assembles the one payload both REST and MCP serve, never throwing on bad data.

modules.name: scalp-context (REST)
modules.role: The GPT Action endpoint: checks the bearer key, returns the payload or a chart image, and records what was served.

modules.name: editTradesMcp
modules.role: Registers the single read-only MCP tool get_scalp_context; no trading tool can ever be reached from here.

modules.name: mcpHttp
modules.role: Carries MCP requests over HTTP inside the REST function (Vercel's 12-function cap) without sharing its auth.

modules.name: chartRender
modules.role: Draws the confirmation chart PNG (candles, EMAs, zones, flag levels) the GPT asks for before a GO IN.

modules.name: servedCalls
modules.role: Saves every call the GPT was actually served so the tracker can score it like a scheduled capture.

modules.name: journal (REST)
modules.role: Stores the trades you tell the GPT about (log / journal) and returns the latest ones; never executes anything.

modules.name: journalSchema
modules.role: Checks each journal line and keeps only the allowed fields, so no wallet or key detail is ever stored.

modules.name: blobJsonl
modules.role: Appends journal and served-call lines to Vercel Blob safely when two writes race.

modules.name: telegram-webhook
modules.role: Answers your Telegram commands (signals, why, flags, chart, wallet, journal, status, log) from the same context build and journals /log lines; never executes anything.

modules.name: telegram-cron
modules.role: Runs every minute, compares the fresh context with telegram/state.json and sends only new GOOD, new SETUP, GOOD-ended and lasting data or mark alerts.

modules.name: telegram
modules.role: Formats the payload into Telegram messages, decides which alert transitions fire, and talks to the Bot API with a 5 second timeout.

modules.name: telegramLog
modules.role: Appends one line per sent Telegram alert and one per engine candidate state or plan-status change to Blob day files the tracker pulls.

modules.name: health
modules.role: A ping that says the deployment is up; no market data.

modules.name: scalp-context.yaml
modules.role: The field-by-field contract of the payload the GPT Action reads.

stages.title: Tracker
stages.purpose: Captures calls every 10 minutes, scores them on later candles and publishes this site.

modules.name: collect
modules.role: Pulls the payload, served calls and your journal into the tracker store, stripping every wallet field first.

modules.name: records
modules.role: Defines the one row shape a captured call is stored in, shared with the engine's served-call recorder.

modules.name: store
modules.role: Reads and writes the tracker's append-only files.

modules.name: score
modules.role: Walks each call forward on stored 1m candles and records TP1, stop, not filled or expired.

modules.name: walk-outcome
modules.role: The exact candle-walk the engine's replay uses, copied so the tracker scores the same way.

modules.name: aggregate
modules.role: Turns scored calls into win rate, expectancy (gross and net) and per-class checks.

modules.name: costs
modules.role: Applies fees and slippage (long 0.34%, short 0.14%) to turn gross R into net R.

modules.name: paths
modules.role: Labels how every flag actually played out after it tightened.

modules.name: flag-paths
modules.role: The path labeller (retest go, runner, false break, fail first, chop) shared by the tracker and the engine's outlook.

modules.name: calibration
modules.role: Checks whether the path outlook's predictions came true.

modules.name: shadow
modules.role: Scores the breakout-close entry against the retest entry, never traded.

modules.name: breakout-entry
modules.role: Builds and walks the shadow breakout-close entry for the shadow scorer.

modules.name: v3-shadow
modules.role: Scores what the stricter v3 variant (gross minRR 3.0, the former live rule) would have called, never traded.

modules.name: alerts
modules.role: Opens a GitHub issue (which emails you) for each new GOOD call, with its chart.

modules.name: charts
modules.role: Draws the equity curve and wallet chart on the tracker page.

modules.name: build-page
modules.role: Builds the call tracker page and report from the scored data.

modules.name: how-to-page
modules.role: Builds the static how-to-use-with-ChatGPT page.

modules.name: changelog-page
modules.role: Draws this system map and changelog from the architecture map and CHANGELOG.

modules.name: build-changelog
modules.role: Reads the synced map, changelog and latest capture versions and writes the system map page.

modules.name: page-style
modules.role: The shared look of every tracker page (Nothing style, light and dark).

modules.name: bento
modules.role: The shared tile and section building blocks of every tracker page.

modules.name: sync
modules.role: Copies the tracker scripts, workflow and engine map/changelog into the tracker repo.

stages.title: GPT
stages.purpose: Tells the Custom GPT how to read the payload and answer you.

modules.name: GPT instructions
modules.role: The GPT's rulebook: commands, answer format, GO IN threshold, and that the engine owns every level.

modules.name: GPT playbook
modules.role: The longer field-by-field playbook the instructions point to, kept out of the size-limited box.

modules.name: check-gpt-instructions
modules.role: Fails if the instructions grow past the GPT's size limit.

stages.title: Off the live path
stages.purpose: Nov-Dec 2025 dashboard, scanner, AI agent and trading code; nothing here feeds the live call.

modules.name: analyze
modules.role: Old dashboard endpoint: 4h strategy analysis for one symbol.

modules.name: analyze-compact
modules.role: Old trimmed strategy analysis for an LLM.

modules.name: analyze-full
modules.role: Old full strategy object with every strategy, including no-trade ones.

modules.name: indicators (API)
modules.role: Old per-symbol indicator endpoint.

modules.name: scan
modules.role: Old market scanner endpoint.

modules.name: agent-review
modules.role: Old AI reasoning agent that sent market JSON to ChatGPT.

modules.name: review-trade
modules.role: Old post-trade review against its signal.

modules.name: parse-trade-image
modules.role: Old screenshot-to-trade parser.

modules.name: execute-trade
modules.role: Trade execution endpoint; off unless explicitly enabled, never reachable from MCP or the GPT.

modules.name: signalEngine
modules.role: Old confluence signal engine; not used by the live call.

modules.name: advancedChartAnalysis
modules.role: Old market structure, volume profile and fair value gap analysis.

modules.name: chartAnalysis
modules.role: Old candlestick pattern names; its output does not reach the live decision.

modules.name: confluenceScoring
modules.role: Old multi-factor confidence score.

modules.name: dataValidation
modules.role: Old clean-up of the advanced chart analysis output.

modules.name: levels
modules.role: Old support and resistance finder, replaced by geometry.

modules.name: momentumAlignment
modules.role: Old RSI / Stoch RSI alignment check.

modules.name: tradeReadiness
modules.role: Old 0-100 readiness meter.

modules.name: volumeAnalysis
modules.role: Old volume trend check.

modules.name: types
modules.role: Old type definitions for the dashboard export.

modules.name: strategy-refactored
modules.role: An unused rewrite of the strategy engine.

modules.name: scanner
modules.role: Old all-coins opportunity scanner.

modules.name: binance
modules.role: Old Binance candle source.

modules.name: coingecko
modules.role: Old CoinGecko candle fallback.

modules.name: dflow
modules.role: Old prediction-market data reader.

modules.name: tradeExecution
modules.role: Places swaps or perps from a signal; only behind the disabled execute-trade gate.

modules.name: walletManager
modules.role: Signing wallet for the execution path; never used by the live call.

modules.name: positionManager
modules.role: Old in-memory position tracker for executed perps.

modules.name: perpsProvider
modules.role: Picks Drift or Mango for perps execution.

modules.name: driftPerps
modules.role: Drift perps execution client.

modules.name: mangoPerps
modules.role: Mango perps execution client.

modules.name: jupiterPerps
modules.role: Jupiter perps execution client.

modules.name: jup-perps-wrapper
modules.role: Loader shim for the Jupiter perps client.

modules.name: jupiterSwap
modules.role: Jupiter spot swap client for the execution path.

modules.name: tokenMapping
modules.role: Maps symbols to Solana token addresses for swaps.
